title: LatENSO v1.0: a learned latent state of the tropical Pacific for seasonal ENSO operators and forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.34296v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Here we present LatENSO v1.0, a machine-learning forecast system for the El Ni\~no-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) built around a learned, 32-dimensional state of the tropical Pacific. A Swin-transformer autoencoder compresses thirteen monthly-averaged ocean and atmosphere fields into 32 numbers, trained to reconstruct the fields, with no forecast target. The 32 numbers rebuild the fields as well as O(100) empirical orthogonal functions. Two seasonal operators use this state. The first is the extended nonlinear recharge oscillator (XRO) with two directions of the learned state among its variables; we call it XRO-lat. The second is a Floquet modal operator (FMO) of three damped oscillators, which forecasts a correction added to a least-squares base forecast made from four observed predictors. translated_title: LatENSO v1.0：一个用于季节性ENSO算子与预报的热带太平洋学习潜在状态
translated_abstract: 我们在此提出LatENSO v1.0，这是一个围绕学习得到的32维热带太平洋状态构建的厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）机器学习预报系统。一个Swin-transformer自编码器将十三个月平均的海洋和大气场压缩为32个数，其训练目标仅为场的重构，不包含任何预报目标。这32个数对场的重构能力可与约百（O(100)）个经验正交函数相当。两个季节算子使用这一状态。第一个是扩展非线性充电振荡器（XRO），将学习状态的两个方向纳入其变量之中，我们称之为XRO-lat。第二个是由三个阻尼振荡器构成的Floquet模态算子（FMO），它预报一个修正量，并将该修正量叠加到由四个观测预测因子构建的最小二乘基准预报之上。我们将这两个算子与充电振荡器、XRO以及深度回声状态网络（DESN）进行对比评估，所有模型均在相同的数据、交叉验证折和（……）上重新拟合
tldr: 该论文提出LatENSO v1.0系统，利用Swin-transformer自编码器将热带太平洋13个月平均海气场压缩为一个32维的学习潜在状态，并基于该状态构建XRO-lat和Floquet模态算子两种季节算子，实现ENSO的季节预报。
en_tdlr: LatENSO v1.0 uses a Swin-transformer autoencoder to compress thirteen tropical Pacific ocean-atmosphere fields into a learned 32-dimensional latent state that powers two seasonal ENSO forecasting operators, XRO-lat and a Floquet modal operator.
